finding: Hash chain uses raw SHA-256 without HMAC — trivial tampering
evidence: Line 203: createHash('sha256').update(canonical).digest('hex') — no secret key. Anyone with DB read access can recompute valid hashes for modified rows.
suggested_fix: Use HMAC-SHA256 with dedicated signing key: createHmac('sha256', SIGNING_KEY).update(canonical).digest('hex'). Store signing key in HSM/KMS.

finding: Rate limiter fail-open design allows complete bypass under Redis DoS
evidence: getCurrentCount returns 0 on Redis error (lines 211-221); checkLimit allows request when Redis unavailable. Plan explicitly states 'fail-open for availability' (phase-02:34,113).
suggested_fix: Fail-closed for authenticated endpoints. Fail-open ONLY for public health checks. Add circuit breaker with alerting.

finding: PBKDF2 iterations = 100,000 — 10x below 2026 minimum
evidence: Line 152: const ITERATIONS = 100_000; OWASP 2026 recommends 600,000+ for PBKDF2-SHA256.
suggested_fix: Minimum 600,000 iterations. Better: migrate to Argon2id (memory-hard) via @noble/hashes or argon2 native.

finding: No key rotation implementation — version prefix is vaporware
evidence: encryptString returns ciphertext:iv:tag with no version byte (lines 271-275). decryptString splits on ':' — cannot detect version (lines 278-283). Rotating master key corrupts all existing ciphertext.
suggested_fix: Prepend version byte: v1:ciphertext:iv:tag. Support multiple key versions in decryptString with key ID lookup.

finding: Single master key encrypts all tenants — blast radius = entire platform
evidence: envKey() returns single key for all encryption (line 272). No per-tenant key derivation, no key hierarchy.
suggested_fix: Envelope encryption. Master key encrypts per-tenant DEKs. DEKs encrypt credentials. Rotate DEKs independently.

finding: Sequence number race condition — concurrent writes break ordering
evidence: getNextSequenceNumber uses MAX(sequence_number) + 1 (line 133) — classic lost-update race. Phase 01 risk table acknowledges this (row 116).
suggested_fix: SELECT sequence_number FROM tenant_audit_logs WHERE tenant_id = $1 FOR UPDATE or PostgreSQL advisory lock pg_advisory_xact_lock(hash(tenant_id)).

finding: Tenant ID resolution from untrusted headers — spoofable
evidence: defaultGetUserId falls back to req.headers['x-user-id'] (lines 387-394) — user-controlled header.
suggested_fix: Tenant ID MUST come from validated auth context (req.user.id set by auth middleware). Reject request if missing.

finding: GCM without Associated Data (AAD) — ciphertext malleable across contexts
evidence: cipher.update(plaintext, 'utf8') with no cipher.setAAD() call (lines 45-55). Ciphertext for api_key can be swapped with private_key ciphertext.
suggested_fix: Include tenant_id + field_name as AAD: cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from(tenantId + ':' + fieldName)).

finding: Two conflicting migrations for same table — schema drift guaranteed
evidence: 021 has tenant_id TEXT, encrypted columns. 029 has subscriber_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, plaintext columns. Plan says 'check actual DB schema' (phase-03:122) — not a plan.
suggested_fix: Audit production schema NOW. Write single canonical migration 042 that reconciles both.

finding: IP hashing unsalted SHA-256 — enables IP enumeration
evidence: Line 35: createHash('sha256').update(input).digest('hex') — deterministic, no salt. Attacker with DB access builds rainbow table.
suggested_fix: Per-deployment salt in secret manager: createHmac('sha256', IP_HASH_SALT).update(input).digest('hex').

finding: Decryption error messages leak oracle — timing/padding oracle surface
evidence: Line 86-87: throw new Error(`decryption failed: ${msg}`) — exposes internal error (auth tag vs padding vs encoding).
suggested_fix: Constant-time error: always throw generic Error('decryption failed') with no detail.

finding: No audit of GUC audit.cleanup_allowed changes — silent immutability bypass
evidence: Trigger checks current_setting('audit.cleanup_allowed', true) <> 'on' (line 18). Any superuser can SET audit.cleanup_allowed = 'on'; no audit trail.
suggested_fix: Require signed attestation for cleanup. Log GUC changes to separate immutable table. Alert on any SET audit.cleanup_allowed.

finding: No rate limiting on auth endpoints — brute force unchecked
evidence: Plan mentions tier integration but no mention of /login, /register, /forgot-password endpoints.
suggested_fix: Separate strict rate limiter (5 req/min/IP) on auth endpoints, independent of tier.

finding: Clock skew between app and Redis — window boundary bypass
evidence: Uses Date.now() for window calculation (~line 140). Phase 02 notes 'Use Redis server time via TIME command' but not implemented.
suggested_fix: Fetch TIME from Redis once at startup, use offset for all window calculations.

finding: Redis sorted set operations not atomic — check-then-act race
evidence: zremrangebyscore (remove old) → zcard (count) → zadd (add new) — three separate round trips (lines 130-150).
suggested_fix: Lua script for atomic check-and-increment. Or Redis 7.2+ ZMPOP/ZADD with GT/LT options.

finding: Tier limits hardcoded in rate limiter — config drift from pricing
evidence: TIER_RATE_LIMITS defines FREE: { requests: 60, windowMs: 60000 } (lines 16-25) but pricing tiers have requestsPerMin.
suggested_fix: Single source of truth. Import tier config from canonical location (src/platform/billing/pricing-tiers.ts).

finding: public_key column unencrypted
evidence: Line 11: public_key TEXT — no _encrypted suffix, not in repository encrypt/decrypt.
suggested_fix: Encrypt all credential fields consistently.

finding: No key destruction in memory — keys persist in heap
evidence: envKey() returns Buffer never zeroed. Heap dump / core dump / gcore reveals master key.
suggested_fix: Use crypto.webcrypto.subtle with CryptoKey (non-extractable) or zero Buffer after use: key.fill(0).

finding: Audit middleware sanitization incomplete — SENSITIVE_KEYS missing fields
evidence: SENSITIVE_KEYS includes password, token, secret, key — misses apiSecret, passphrase, privateKey, accessToken, refreshToken (lines 138-150).
suggested_fix: Comprehensive deny-list OR allow-list approach. Test with credential-shaped objects.

finding: Hash chain verification not enforced on read — silent corruption
evidence: verifyChain exists (lines 195-224) but not called in getLogs or getLogBySequence. Tampered logs returned as valid.
suggested_fix: getLogs MUST verify chain prefix. Throw on mismatch. Add background verification job.

finding: No distributed lock for hash chain backfill — migration unsafe at scale
evidence: Plan says 'Run during maintenance window; backfill in batches if >100k rows' (row 118). Concurrent writes during backfill produce wrong previous_hash links.
suggested_fix: Advisory lock per tenant during backfill. Or pg_try_advisory_xact_lock with retry.

finding: Rate limiter key uses {tenant_id} hash tag — but no validation of format
evidence: const key = `ratelimit:{${tenantId}}:${endpoint}` (line 140). validateTenantId only checks non-empty string.
suggested_fix: Strict regex validation: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$.

finding: No test for cross-tenant data leakage in rate limiter
evidence: Phase 04 has no test case for tenant isolation.
suggested_fix: Integration test: concurrent requests from two tenants, verify independent counters.

finding: Encryption test uses fixed key — doesn't test key rotation
evidence: FIXTURE_KEY hardcoded (lines 12-15). Version handling, key rotation, multi-key decrypt never exercised.
suggested_fix: Tests generating random keys, encrypting with v1, rotating to v2, decrypting both.

finding: Audit log ip_hash column NOT NULL but middleware allows undefined
evidence: Migration 038: ip_hash TEXT NOT NULL (line 24). Middleware calls hashIpAddress(req.ip) where req.ip can be undefined (line 60). hashIpAddress handles undefined silently.
suggested_fix: Make ip_hash nullable OR require explicit IP resolution upstream.

finding: No migration rollback test — down functions untested
evidence: All migrations have down but Phase 04 doesn't test rollback.
suggested_fix: CI job that applies migration, verifies, rolls back, verifies schema clean.
